source.title: Easton Zoning (CT Metro COG, Easton_Zoning MapServer layer 1)

method: Sum of Shape_Area (state-plane feet squared, EPSG:2234 / wkid 102656, NAD83 CT State Plane ftUS, so no projection correction needed) grouped by Zone via outStatistics; converted to acres via /43560. Total = 18256 acres (layer polygons include water; the town land-area figure on the town page is 17110 acres). Layer contains only two zones, RA and RB, one polygon each.
